name: Maltegians Anthem

tracks.code: anthem(kick, kick, kick, silence, kickLift, kick, kick)

anthem(silence, clap, clapReply, silence,
  s("<sd*2 sd*2 sd*4 sd*8>/2").bank('tr909').gain(0.055), clapReply, clap)
anthem(hats, hats, hats, silence, hats, hatsFull, hats)

anthem(silence, percussion, stack(percussion, wood), rim,
  rim, stack(percussion, wood), openHat)

anthem(silence, bass, stack(bass, bassReply), silence,
  bass.gain(0.10), stack(bass, bassReply), bass)

anthem(silence, silence, melody, response.gain(0.03), call,
  melody, silence)

anthem(pad.gain(0.018), keys, keys, pad, pad,
  stack(keys, pad.gain(0.013)), keys.gain(0.02))

anthem(silence, silence, voice, echoVoice, silence,
  stack(voice, echoVoice), silence)
